ops.body:
# cci-fix-2 handoff

Successor of cci-fix-1 (handoff ccn doc 3ab5b31). Brief came by SendMessage from the release-v3 root; the owner rule makes every cci bug a lane's job. Prose may be written on Opus when codex is down (owner ruling 7:0x AM Oct 5).

## Landed (squash-merged on yasyf/cc-inbox main, CI green)

- v0.6.0: #22 `--budget` governs with no 16,000 cap and tail, watch, and digest print whole records by default (SessionStart keeps width 400). #23 a text grep with no match prints `no records on <drive> match; store head #<seq>`. #24 text digest lists imported holds with no `stack:`/`target:` ref on an `untracked holds` line, and JSON adds `untracked_holds`. #25 the newer-schema error names the running version and the upgrade command for that install: brew cask, plugin binrun cache, or a release tarball.
- v0.6.1: #26 text digest defaults to a 32,000-byte budget so every section prints whole. 16,000 truncates full sections at 15,796 bytes, per TestDigestDefaultBudgetFitsEverySection.
- Installed 0.6.1 everywhere: ~/.local/bin/cci (checksum-verified tarball), /opt/homebrew/bin/cci (cask yasyf/tap/cci), plugin cc-inbox@cc-inbox 0.6.1, daemon com.yasyf.cc-inbox (via `cci serve`).

## Findings

- Grep freshness (root's 2:3x AM report) was already fixed in 0.5.0: an appended line greps in 1.6 s, and every import offset equals its file size.
- Version skew (defect 12): releases already publish to the tap cask and re-render plugin/bin/cci.binrun. The skew came from copies nobody upgraded. Root chose to keep binrun, with no second resolver.
- syspolicyd wedge: the first exec of a fresh cask binary stalls in _dyld_start; stripping quarantine did not help. Workaround used: `ln -f ~/.local/bin/cci /opt/homebrew/Caskroom/cci/<v>/cci` after a sha256 match. The root fix is the owner running `sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.apple.security.syspolicy`.
- ccx papercut 3dfdc2f (monorepo cc-notes): `ship --no-commit` after a local amend replays onto the stale remote branch. Force-pushing a stacked PR before retargeting it fires no CI; retarget first.

## Release mechanics

Detach at origin/main, move Unreleased into a dated section, add compare links, commit `chore(release): vX.Y.Z`, push to main, then tag and push the tag. release.yml takes about 7 minutes. Then install the tarball into ~/.local/bin, run `cci serve`, `claude plugin marketplace update cc-inbox` and `claude plugin update cc-inbox@cc-inbox`, `brew upgrade --cask yasyf/tap/cci` (detached), and the hard-link step above.

## Open

None. Worktree removed; local branches deleted.
